Jensen Huang’s Net Worth Soars
Nvidia stock had one of its
based on percentage gains and the company set a new single-day record with $954.3 billion in market capitalization added.
Shares ended the day up 31.48% to close at $165.05, marking the highest level since Huang’s departure.
With the move, Huang added $33.7 billion to his net worth, according to Forbes. This represented a 31.6% gain in his net worth to total $143.8 billion.
Huang remains outside the top 10 billionaires, ranking 13th as of Monday. He would need Nvidia stock to keep gaining to reach a net worth of $151.8 billion to rejoin the top 10.
While Huang posted the biggest percentage gain in net worth Monday, his dollar gain ranked second behind
Elon Musk.
The world’s richest man, Musk added $44.1 billion to his net worth Monday, hitting a new total of $855.8 billion. The gain came with overall market optimism from Huang’s return to Nvidia.

In 2025, Huang
ranked ninth richest in the world with a net worth of $154 billion. Last year, Huang gained $40.1 billion in net worth as Nvidia stock increased.
Huang finished 2024 ranked as the world’s 12th-richest person.
Nvidia stock is down 21.8% over the last month and down 11.50% year-to-date.

Shares could continue to rally on news of Huang’s return. Even with Monday’s move, the stock still trades below the Nov. 11 closing price of $173.73. This was the closing price the day before Huang’s resignation announcement.
